description:
The Blue Grass Army Depot, CCRI-MII-B Depot Support Branch/Munitions and Industrial Base Directorate Army Contracting Command - Rock Island intends to establish a Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) under the modernized authority of the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO), specifically leveraging RFO 12.201-1(e)(3) and Class Deviation RFO-2025-16. The BPA will facilitate the streamlined, repetitive procurement of services and repair parts to perform diagnostic troubleshooting, emergency and routine repairs, preventative maintenance, software programming, and operator/programmer training for covered systems that include: 

 CNC Machinery: HAAS Mini Mill, HAAS VF6, HAAS SL10, Doosan Puma 2600SY. 

 Robotic Motion Systems & Controllers: FANUC Robots (M-20iA, R-2000iB); FANUC Controllers (M-20iA, R-30iA). 

 Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs): Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Siemens (all variants utilizing industrial ladder/logic software). 

 This combined synopsis and solicitation serves as the official public notice of the Government's intent to establish a BPA. The primary objective is to create a flexible “charge account” with a qualified, responsible source to fulfill anticipated repetitive needs efficiently. 

 This requirement utilizes the North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS) 811310 Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance with a size standard of $12.5 Million. 

 This BPA shall not obligate any funds. A BPA is not a Contract. In accordance with FAR 12.201-1-3(e)(3)(iv)(B), the Government is obligated only to the extent of authorized purchases made via properly executed BPA Call Orders made under the BPA. The BPA Master Limit is $750,000. No single BPA Call Order shall exceed $250,000 in total cost. 

 Please note, there is no guarantee that any or all requirements for the services described herein will be issued using an established BPA. The full details and applicable provisions and clauses are available in the attachments of this notice.
